text:
DeployBot: starting rollout v4.1.2 -> prod. Canary: 6% traffic. Observability: embeddings-api p95 increased ~60% on canary. Autorevert: enabled but deferred pending human decision. Please ack and advise rollback scope.
Linh: ack. reproduces on canary hosts only, embeddings route affected.
Theo: logs show increased KV eviction and CPU steal on canary nodes. text-gen unaffected.
SRE_Jordan: recommend targeted rollback (route-level pin) rather than full revert to keep other features live.
OpsAnna: who can run the traffic override? I have perms but need ops+sre approval per change window policy.
PM_Naveen: comms note — freeze release notes; if we pin route, publish short customer advisory for enterprise seats.
CS_Dev: I'll pull a list of high-QPS embeddings customers and stand by.
Theo: ops command to pin embeddings route to stable version v4.0.9: 
```
redwoodctl route override --route embeddings --version v4.0.9 --reason "canary p95 regression" --expires 45m
```
DeployBot: reminder: overrides during the change window require dual confirmation (Ops + SRE). Cutoff for automated revert: 3473001180.
OpsAnna: executing now; SRE_Jordan please confirm.
OpsAnna: /run redwoodctl route override --route embeddings --version v4.0.9 --reason "manual-pin-canary-latency" --expires 45m
SRE_Jordan: confirmed. approving override.
DeployBot: action accepted: embeddings route pinned to v4.0.9 by OpsAnna at 3473001138. Canary traffic for new runtime set to 0% for embeddings.
Linh: monitoring — p95 back to baseline within 90s. errors down. :thumbsup:
PM_Naveen: adding blurb to release metadata: "embeddings routed back to stable runtime v4.0.9 due to canary latency regression; investigating root cause." Freezing other release notes until flag cleared.
CS_Dev: customer advisory ready: "We routed embeddings traffic to a stable runtime after a performance regression was observed in canary. No data loss. We will update when fixed." Ready to send to enterprise list on PM approval.
SRE_Jordan: creating revert PR (repo@commit 0f9e1b2) in case we need a code revert later.
Theo: runbook: 1) reproduce in staging, 2) run microbench with KV pressure, 3) test GC/eviction knobs, 4) patch & redeploy canary.
OpsAnna: override expires at 3473001418 unless extended. Will extend if needed.
DeployBot: archived incident under INC-2026-047. Logs stored in incident/INC-2026-047.
Linh: filing postmortem stub and assigning owners.
PM_Naveen: approved customer advisory; CS_Dev please send.
CS_Dev: advisory sent to enterprise list.
SRE_Jordan: monitoring set to watch for 30m; if p95 > 1.5x baseline we escalate to full rollback.
Theo: thanks team. Good containment.
OpsAnna: closing this thread; moving notes to postmortems channel.
DeployBot: thread closed by OpsAnna at 3473001199.
